What's your favorite animal and why?

Dogs. I've had a dog virtually for my entire life (less than 10% without one). Owls. I love them because they are basically flying cats with huge eyes that are cute.
Hahaha, flying cats! Love how pleased they look when they are being petted. For example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3G1PFLuTrgM :)

Cats. I have owned cats my entire life. They are far superior to humans in my eyes. I would save my cat from a house fire before I would save myself. I wish I lived in ancient egypt so I could worship cats without being labeled a freak.

And sadly, no. None of this is sarcastic. I actually just love cats that much.
Yes, cats! Now be honest, how many nicknames do you have for your cat? I have two cats and call them a billion different things.
Oh, probably about a billion as well. And many of them have nothing to do with her actual name. You know how it is.
White Siberian Tigers, because they are so majestic.
Goats, Humans always tend to worship them, and I enjoy when they do.

Pangolins because they're cute when they're just babies, then turn into badass looking adults.

Baby pangolin

Adult pangolin
Omg, that is cute as fuck! It looks like it should be on Super Smash Bros or something.

If you like pandas, you'll probably like my favorite animal: Red pandas! They're like a cat, panda, raccoon and sea otter into one! They always look like they're having fun and it just makes me smile watching them.

Ravens! Because they're big, black... birds. But actually I like them because they're highly intelligent and can also be found in many different folklores around the world, making them kinda mythical to me
Hippopotamus, because they're unsuspecting. They're actually the most deadly animals to humans in Africa, not lions.
Ducks. They don't do anything. They just quack all day while chilling in a lake... I envy their lifestyle.
Cats. I just feel like I relate to their personalities somehow.

For me, it's cats, too. I have given up trying to not be labeled as a crazy cat lady. I spend my spare time working with animal rescue groups and trying to get fur off of everything. I have enough to make four new cats!
